text:
Type: slipcovered sofa with chaise longue
Use: seating, lounging with legs up; living room, family room, TV room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: removable fabric slipcover, soft loose cushions
Colors: medium grey, cool tone
Shape: rounded rolled arms, loose back and seat cushions, chaise on the right, skirted base hiding the legs, deep and bulky
Feel: cozy, relaxed, homey
Goes with: white walls, light or painted wood, linen and cream textiles; farmhouse, coastal or traditional living rooms

product.name: EKTORP
product.description: Seat cushions filled with high resilience foam and polyester fibre wadding give comfortable support for your body, and easily regain their shape when you get up.
